text: Biology is the science that studies life phenomena and their laws, covering multi-level life systems from molecules and cells to individuals, populations and ecosystems. The training objective is: Through systematic study of biological theories, experimental methods and cutting-edge technologies, students will be equipped with the ability to analyze life phenomena, design scientific experiments, interpret data and apply innovative technologies, and be capable of engaging in basic research, technology development, teaching or management in fields such as scientific research, education, medicine, agriculture and environmental protection.
